mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses equity discount rates by reducing the risk-free rate, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as corporate cash flow valuations improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through reduced earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230) trigger aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 850 thousand units signal residential sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 850, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) below 15,500 billion dollars indicates economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 < 15500, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment decline (PAYEMS) and unemployment rise (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 99.0) reduces manufacturing output and corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days in supply-driven downturns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 99.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
